substeps.label: C2 · lengthwise, 1.5 mm off the centreline
substeps.caption: Part 1.1 in the precision saw, its length in the blade's plane: one cut through the base and all seven walls, 1.5 mm off the centreline, on the side away from the wall-1 mark. Keep the offcut and label it: it holds a second plane through every wall.
substeps.watch_out: clamp the part by its base and feed slowly: the 1.27 mm walls can bend or chatter in the cut.

substeps.label: C2 · between walls 4 and 5
substeps.caption: Turn the half a quarter turn and cut between walls 4 and 5, in the 5.9 mm gap: one piece with four walls (about 25 mm long) and one with three (about 19 mm). Each fits a 1.25 in mount.

substeps.label: C2 · the section plane
substeps.caption: Red: the plane to grind to, the part's centreline. It crosses every wall at mid-length, through its 1.27 mm thickness and 7.6 mm height, and the base below. Grinding removes the last 1.5 mm.
